title: Multiplexer Module - Band 66 (AWS) for 5G NR Sub-6 GHz Front-End Module
subtitle: Design Validation and Performance Characterization
author: Dr. Lena Kowalski

sections.1_OBJECTIVE: This document describes the design, simulation, and characterization of a Multiplexer Module filter targeting Band 66 (AWS) for 5G NR Sub-6 GHz Front-End Module. The filter is designed on Quartz substrate with a target center frequency of 4595.3 MHz and bandwidth of 362.6 MHz. The objective is to validate that the filter meets the required insertion loss, rejection, and linearity specifications for integration into the 5G NR Sub-6 GHz Front-End Module module. This design iteration addresses feedback from the previous revision regarding out-of-band rejection improvements and temperature stability.
sections.2_SCOPE:
- Filter Type: Multiplexer Module
- Frequency Band: Band 66 (AWS)
- Application: 5G NR Sub-6 GHz Front-End Module
- Substrate: Quartz
- Package: CSP (Chip Scale Package)
- Design Tool: Keysight ADS 2024
- Design Center: Newbury Park Design Center

This specification applies to all variants of the Multiplexer Module design targeting Band 66 (AWS). Results are used to qualify the design for mass production release.
sections.3_DESIGN_PARAMETERS:
Center Frequency:       4595.3 MHz
Bandwidth (3 dB):       362.6 MHz
Insertion Loss Target:  <= 1.3 dB
Return Loss Target:     >= 13.0 dB
Out-of-Band Rejection:  >= 32.0 dB
Isolation (Duplexer):   >= 26.0 dB
Q Factor:               8368
Temperature Coefficient:-22.8 ppm/°C
Die Size:               0.9 x 2.1 mm
Wafer Size:             8-inch
Number of Resonators:   8
Electrode Material:     Pt/Al
Passivation:            SiO2/Si3N4 stack
sections.4_TEST_PROCEDURE:
1. Open Keysight ADS 2024 and load the Multiplexer Module template project.
2. Define the substrate stack: Quartz with specified layer thicknesses.
3. Set design targets: center freq 4595.3 MHz, BW 362.6 MHz.
4. Run initial EM simulation with 2D mesh density of 20 cells/wavelength.
5. Optimize resonator geometry using gradient descent (target IL < 1.3 dB).
6. Verify coupling coefficients between resonator stages.
7. Run 3D FEM simulation to account for package parasitics (CSP (Chip Scale Package)).
8. Export GDS-II layout for mask fabrication.
9. Fabricate prototype wafers (8-inch, Quartz).
10. Perform on-wafer probing using Rohde & Schwarz ZNB40.
11. Measure S-parameters (S11, S21, S12, S22) from 100 MHz to 13786 MHz.
12. Compare measured results against simulation and specification limits.
13. Perform temperature cycling (-40°C to +85°C) and re-measure.
14. Document results and generate summary report.
sections.5_ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA:
- Insertion loss at center frequency shall be <= 1.3 dB
- Return loss in passband shall be >= 13.0 dB
- Out-of-band rejection at +/- 544 MHz offset >= 32.0 dB
- Group delay variation across passband shall be <= 10 ns
- Temperature drift over -40°C to +85°C shall be <= 13.1 MHz
- Power handling shall be >= +26 dBm at 1 dB compression
- ESD tolerance >= 500 V (HBM)
- Die yield on qualification lot >= 87%
sections.6_TEST_RESULTS:
Measurement Date:       2025-01-26
Devices Tested:         27
Insertion Loss (meas):  0.97 dB
Return Loss (meas):     14.6 dB
Rejection (meas):       34.8 dB
Isolation (meas):       31.2 dB
Q Factor (meas):        8368
Group Delay Variation:  1.2 ns
Power Handling:         +28 dBm
Die Yield:              96.7%

Result Classification:  CONDITIONAL PASS
sections.7_OBSERVATIONS:
a) The Multiplexer Module design demonstrated acceptable performance for Band 66 (AWS).
b) Insertion loss met target specification.
c) Out-of-band rejection exceeded the minimum requirement.
d) Slight frequency drift observed at +85°C; TC layer thickness may need adjustment.
e) Cross-talk between adjacent filter channels was below -55 dB.
sections.8_CORRECTIVE_ACTIONS:
1. Review near-band rejection margin for worst-case temperature.
2. Re-run EM simulation with refined mesh for better accuracy.
3. Schedule follow-up measurement after design tweak.
